content:
The analysis failed due to schema mismatches in the assumptions dictionary and missing comma formatting in the summary text.
The test_schema_and_assumptions failed because the output contained 'patients' and 'packaging_card_cost_basis' instead of the expected 'patients_per_medication' and 'switch_threshold_usd'. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the summary text lacked comma separators in currency values, failing to match the expected string '-42,908.83' against the actual output '$-42908.83'. Avoid omitting required keys in the 'assumptions' object and ensure all monetary values in the summary use standard US comma formatting.
